title: get_property_details request
description: Body of POST /api/v1/property-details: the get_property_details tool arguments. Non-logged-in journey: no user, member or session fields. propertyCode or propertyName is required; every other field has a server default (config.yaml). Enforced by dwl/validate-request.dwl, which also accepts checkinDate / checkoutDate as aliases and ignores unknown fields.

propertyName.description: Looked up in property-codes.json when no propertyCode is given.

checkin.description: Default: today + default.checkinOffsetDays. Not before today.

checkout.description: Default: checkin + default.nights. After checkin, at most request.maxNights nights.

maxPois.description: Upper bound for nearby[]; 0 skips the POI call.
